name: DocStruct4M
description: DocStruct4M is a comprehensive training dataset for structure-aware learning in visual document understanding, covering five domains: document, webpage, table, chart, and natural image. It supports multimodal large language models in understanding layout and structure without OCR.
reputation: A relatively new but increasingly cited benchmark/dataset in document AI research, especially for OCR-free structure-aware multimodal learning.
notes: Dataset enables training for structure-aware parsing and multi-grained text localization in text-rich images; supports OCR-free document understanding.
